facts.fact: The release says the Kenya Bureau of Standards has existed since 1974 and provides standards development, metrology, conformity assessment, training and certification services; it names no IT or data standard issued by it and no law.

systems.owner: African Organisation for Standardisation (ARSO); certification scheme hosted by Science for Africa Foundation

note: No certification fact: GFGP is an ARSO continental grant-governance standard, not a Kenyan national IT or data standard; KEBS certification services are mentioned generically and no certifier, IT standard or public body is named.
